attributes.context: This provision appears in Section 4 of the agreement, among operational terms, next to a similar clause stating there shall be no restriction on raw or manufactured plastering and lathing materials except prison-made.

extraction_text: There shall be no restriction as to the use of any machinery and tools by employees or employers. All tools or machinery of whatsoever kind may be used in all trades, or in the manufacture of any material entering into the construction of buildings, except prison-made.
